description: Read a public video as text: author, description, stats and a timestamped transcript of the audio. Use this whenever the user shares a video link. Costs a small fee that grows with the video's length, paid automatically; failed lookups are not charged.

url.description: The video URL: TikTok, YouTube/Shorts, Instagram Reels or X, or any other public page or direct video file link (read only if that site allows automated access).

visuals.description: Also describe what is shown and read on-screen text. Costs several times more; use when the video's content is visual (screen recordings, demos, text overlays) rather than spoken.

name: watch_video
title: Watch a video
